tools.name: check_filing_deadline
tools.description: Call this when a user asks when a business tax return is due: Form 1065, 1120-S, 1120 or Schedule C (IRS), or the T2 / T1 (CRA). Returns the federal due dates and extension dates for that entity and tax year, the Quebec or Alberta corporate return rule when relevant, and each date's official source

tools.name: get_annual_report_info
tools.description: Call this when a user asks about an LLC or corporation annual report, biennial report, statement of information or annual return: whether it's required in their state or province, when it's due and the state fee. Returns the rule with its official source URL and checked date.

tools.name: get_sales_tax_registration
tools.description: Call this when a user asks whether they need a sales tax permit, seller's permit or GST/HST/PST registration, what it's called, or which agency issues it, for a US state or Canadian province. tools.name: get_cra_instalment_dates
tools.description: Call this when a Canadian user asks when income tax instalments are due or whether they have to pay instalments, as an individual (self-employed) or a corporation. Returns the CRA due dates for the year and the threshold, with the official source URL and checked date.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_filing_deadline, get_annual_report_info, get_sales_tax_registration, get_cra_instalment_dates, start_onboarding · Private data: list_required_documents · Public sink: start_onboarding.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_filing_deadline, get_annual_report_info, get_sales_tax_registration, get_cra_instalment_dates, start_onboarding · Private data: list_required_documents · Public sink: start_onboarding

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
